title: Credit underwriting scorecard with model-risk documentation
tagline: WoE logistic scorecard vs monotonic GBM challenger, validated out-of-time, with fair-lending tests, Reg B reason codes and a generated SR 11-7 model card.

metrics.label: Adverse impact ratio
metrics.note: four-fifths rule passed; proxy removal cost 0.0109 AUC

highlights: Monotonic WoE binning and 600 @ 30:1, PDO 20 points scaling, unit-tested
Out-of-time validation: AUC, Gini, KS, calibration by decile, PSI and per-feature CSI
Four-fifths rule and equal-opportunity gap, with a proxy-removal mitigation and its AUC cost
Top-4 ECOA / Reg B adverse action reasons from points lost per characteristic
Profit-based cutoff in integer cents and a generated SR 11-7 style model card
limitations: Synthetic applicants with a logit-additive default process favour the scorecard
No reject inference; PD under-predicts in the stressed OOT window
Single binary protected attribute; flat unit economics

series.name: OOT approval rate vs bad rate of approved loans by cutoff
